title: Immunomodulatory Omega-3 Injectable Hydrogel for Vital Pulp Therapy
html: Biomaterials that both seal the pulp during direct pulp capping (DPC) and actively control inflammation are unusual. Here, we engineered injectable gelatin methacryloyl (GelMA) hydrogels carrying omega-3 polyunsaturated fatty acids. Our null hypothesis states that GelMA and GelMA-omega-3 hydrogels do not differ in their physicochemical, mechanical, cytocompatibility, immunomodulatory, or in vivo effects.
